## Product-quality review

- [ ] Changed behavior has focused regression coverage.
- [ ] User-facing copy is present in the reviewed English/Hindi catalogs, or no new user-facing copy was added.
- [ ] Locale-sensitive numbers/dates/times use `src/i18n/format.ts`.
- [ ] User-created content is not rewritten during locale changes.
- [ ] Keyboard, focus, screen-reader naming, text scaling, contrast, and reduced-motion impact were considered where relevant.
- [ ] Browser and Tauri behavior stay behind product service adapters where relevant.

## Security / privacy review

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, signing keys, private backups, production personal data, configured seeds, or private filesystem paths are committed.
- [ ] No broad filesystem, shell, HTTP, process, wildcard-window, or remote-origin Tauri capability was added without an explicit reviewed boundary change.
- [ ] CSP was not weakened with wildcard sources, `unsafe-eval`, remote network dependencies, or remote-domain IPC.
- [ ] Native command additions/changes preserve static command names, narrow input validation, and the documented command allowlist.
- [ ] Unknown/native failures do not expose raw stacks, private paths, or other sensitive content to users/logs.

## Dependency / release review

- [ ] No dependency manifest changed, or the corresponding generated lockfile is committed.
- [ ] Cargo lockfile changes were generated by Cargo rather than hand-editing transitive entries.
- [ ] Version metadata remains synchronized when version/release metadata changed.
- [ ] Architecture/security/release/roadmap/handoff documentation was updated where behavior or evidence changed.

## Screenshots / evidence

Attach only real, relevant, privacy-safe evidence. Candidate screenshots must come from the candidate build, not mockups. Remove secrets and unrelated personal information before attaching logs or images.

## Follow-up

List separate follow-up issues/work only when needed.
